reviews.review: I think of it as Dark Souls, but side scrolling and futuristic.

Its a great rogue like with incredible pixel art, music, tight mechanics and co-op. When you start a run a timer starts counting up and once it hits certain marks the enemies get harder. Your goal is to collect as many power-ups as possible, awaken/defeat the boss as quickly as possible then progress to the next stage. The game has quite a bit of unlockables new power-ups, relics (Game modifiers) and characters. One of the real fun ways to play the game is to collect relics which are game modifiers, specifically the one that lets you manually choose your power-up.

I usually don't like roguelikes of this kind, but this one is different.

I can't pinpoint what Risk of Rain does right, but I can recomend it. It's hard, yet not always unreasonable. In true roguelike fashion, every failure gets you closer to the goal. 

The music and art are both outstanding.

Love this game, difficult to start off but amazing game all round.

I would love to see more games like this one

As you can clearly see i played the game A LOT! You know why? because it was an AWESOME GAME! but why would i never reccomend this game?

Because of the following: BUGS, BUGS and more BUGS!

- You wanna play it on linux? forget it! it does not work without proton. Not even if you use arch btw.
- you wanna play it with friends? Hahahahaha! You will never establishing a connection to other players online even with a networking degree.
- but how about playing locally? NOPE! two controllers will be recognized as one and even if one takes the keyboard... i had some issues.

Frankly my dear the developer never gave a damn, abandoned this project and moved on to RoR 2! And you my friend, should do it too. Don't throw your money away for a game which feels like an unfinished beta which never even reached early access. Just go straight to the second part of RoR!
